feature: Collection screens PR 4: the short-deck warning (§E) on the upload confirm
note: Needs COLLECTION_EDIT_ENABLED=true and an account with a committed (99-card) deck, so a pasted one-card list leaves it short. Nothing is written: the confirm answers with the warning and the row stops there. Edit copies (PR 7) and revert (PR 6) add rows and views for the same component.

shares.note: ReplaceFlow mounts the warning directly, so each row's `view` is replace-flow.
